title: The Time Machine

vibeProfile.oneLine: A Victorian rides into the far future and finds humanity split in two.

summary: A Victorian inventor builds a machine that carries him hundreds of thousands of years into the future, where he finds humanity split into two species: the gentle, childlike Eloi and the monstrous, subterranean Morlocks who prey on them. Wells turns his time-travel adventure into a dark parable about class, evolution and the possible end of everything. Short, thrilling and startlingly bleak for its age, it more or less invented the time-travel story and still casts a long shadow over science fiction.
whyReadIt: The original time-travel story, and a bleak little parable about where class might lead us. Short and startlingly modern.

funFacts.text: Wells's book gave the world both the time machine as a device and the very phrase.
